# Classes the admin uses that no stylesheet defines.
#
# A frozen baseline, not a target. Most are leftovers from earlier
# markup and some may be JS hooks rather than style hooks; each needs
# its own look. What matters here is that the list only ever shrinks:
# UiClassContractTest fails on a class that is not already on it, which
# is how wb-checkbox went unnoticed in seventeen files.
#
